title: Forge Store Listing v3
description: Canonical format for store-listing-{lang}.json files. v4.10.26 fix: real Yandex constraints (subtitle 20-70 not 3-60, seo 50-160 not 80-200, about 300-1000 not 300-2000, how_to_play 300-1000 not 100-1500). CAPS detection added (no all-caps words >=4 chars в title/subtitle). See skills/fill-yandex/reference/yandex-fields-constraints.md.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code lowercase: ru, en, tr, etc.

title.description: Main game/app title. Yandex: max 50 chars, no CAPS, no emoji, must match in-game name (clause 5.1.3).

subtitle.description: Short description / tagline. Yandex: 20-70 chars, NO CAPS (common AI mistake — was 'БАБКИН ЦЕХ — ПОДПОЛЬНАЯ ИМПЕРИЯ', should be 'Бабкин цех — подпольная империя'). Sensible casing only.

category.description: Store categories. ARRAY 1-3 items. Yandex Console accepts 1-3 categories per game. Values MUST come from skills/fill-yandex/reference/yandex-categories-full.md (25 valid).

tags.description: Search/discovery tags. 5-15 items. ⚠️ FOR YANDEX: tags MUST come from yandex-tags-full.md (~700 valid). AI mistakes: 'idle' → 'тапалки', 'tycoon' → 'магнат', 'СНГ' → 'на русском'+'мемы'.

keywords.description: Yandex Console field 'Ключевые слова через запятую' (per language). Forge stores as array — joined с ', ' для Console submission. User confirms (2026-05-14): field EXISTS в Console for each language card. Length limit TBD pending real Console verification. Recommended 8-20 phrases per language. Used dual purpose: Yandex Console keywords field + Forge ASO tracking + RuStore keywords (which also has this field).

seo_description.description: OPTIONAL — Yandex Console doesn't have this field, but Forge uses для PWA meta + RuStore. Constraint: 50-160 chars single line. Primary keyword + benefit + CTA element ('бесплатно', 'без скачивания', 'прямо в браузере').

about.description: Full description. 300-1000 chars (Yandex limit). Structure: hook saying WHAT (not WHAT TO DO — avoid 'Тапай по...' style; prefer 'Идл-кликер про...') → features with benefits → numbers/specifics → CTA. Newlines OK.

how_to_play.description: Controls + tips. 300-1000 chars (Yandex limit). Minimal emoji (Yandex moderation flags emoji clutter). Structure: PC controls → Mobile controls → 3-5 tips. Newlines OK.

$forbidden.description: Fields that MUST NOT appear. AI invents these. Validator rejects.

rationale._removed_fields: Don't justify omissions — keywords/seo are optional.
rationale.screenshots/icon/promo: Asset refs go в promo.json или assets/. Listing is text-only.

$caps_rule.description: Fields tagged noAllCaps:true reject all-caps words >=4 chars. CAPS subtitles look like 2010-era SEO scam tactics, can flag moderation. Applies к title/subtitle (visible store fields). Acronyms whitelisted: HTML, SDK, API, PC, LMB, RMB, OK, USD, EUR, RUB.
